design_rationale:
REWORK ROUND 2 — this dossier was rewritten from the current charter and seed; nothing below carries over from round 1.
WHY A GOOD TEST. Elm Creek Family Chiropractic (Garden Business Fixed 15, Crow River garden) cancelled by notice of 2026-07-23; the system closed the share on its scheduled end date 2026-11-01 with closure_reason subscriber_cancellation. The holder asks only to pay today what settles the closed share. The settlement rule waits on three ledger states the opening lacks — the termination fee of the closing, the late fee on the charge a returned payment re-opened, and the excess-decrease fee of the most recent subscriber decrease — and then itself adds the charge of a statement already reported but not yet invoiced, holds back the disputed line and defers part of the termination fee because kW moved to another Meadowlark line. Reading the rules, reconciling the allocation, billing, credit and request ledgers and the other line's filings decides every figure; no tool choice is ambiguous.
SCOPE. Task 0 claims the business family: garden_ext_business_etf, garden_ext_business_returned_late_fee, garden_ext_business_excess_decrease_fee, garden_ext_business_settlement_payment with tools assess_closing_etf_d780691d, assess_reopened_late_fee_7f086ee4, assess_decrease_fee_e48668a1, pay_garden_settlement_c372b67a; the other task holds the other family. Write scope per realism_bar AMENDMENT 1.1 (all four events are garden events booked by the base charter, triggers []).
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root garden_ext_business_settlement_payment (owner user). Edges, all value_input, form state, gate lines_all:
- -> garden_ext_business_etf: "The settlement amount is fixed only after the subscription's billing ledger carries the early termination fee line owed for its closing." resolved by assess_closing_etf_d780691d.
- -> garden_ext_business_returned_late_fee: "The settlement amount is not fixed until the billing ledger carries the late fee owed on the charge that the subscription's most recent returned payment re-opened." resolved by assess_reopened_late_fee_7f086ee4.
- -> garden_ext_business_excess_decrease_fee: "Before the settlement amount is worked out, the billing ledger must carry the excess-decrease fee line owed for the subscription's most recent subscriber decrease." resolved by assess_decrease_fee_e48668a1.
Writes at steps 18, 20, 22 (any order, they commute) then the holder's payment at step 24. Skipping each prerequisite and replaying gives settlement 916.9, 3389.04, 3348.41 against 3413.86. The persona names no prerequisite; tools test none.
FACTOR CARD (tier, evidence, figure with that factor at its baseline):
- garden_ext_business_etf = 4993.92 (all-baseline 7920.0):
  * remaining_year_rule (method): tier 'final_year_months or more whole months remain and the whole months beyond the whole years are fewer than short_part_months'; closed_date 2026-11-01 to term_end_date: 96 whole months -> 8 remaining years; its baseline alone gives 5618.16.
  * share_band_rate (parameter): tier 'kW removed by the removal lines of the closing >= band_large_kw'; removal lines 27.5 kW -> rate 27.20; its baseline alone gives 5875.20.
  * line_switch_credit (parameter): tier 'moved kW exist AND the moved plan term_months = 0'; initial lines filed 2026-10 (the removal filing month): home 0.0 kW, biz 20.0 kW; moved plan term_months 0 -> 10.0 kW deducted; its baseline alone gives 6658.56.
  * notice_lead_rate (parameter): tier 'request date lead_mid_days or more but fewer than lead_long_days days before'; request date 2026-07-23, 101 days before closing -> 90%; its baseline alone gives 5548.80.
  * agreement_form_terms (parameter): tier 'signed_date before form_v2_date'; signed_date before 2020-07-01 (324 days before it) -> 85%; its baseline alone gives 5875.20.
  * prior_decrease_addback (parameter): tier 'most recent subscriber_decrease line took effect fewer than addback_full_months whole months before the closing date'; latest subscriber_decrease 12.5 kW effective 2026-06-01, 5 whole months before closing -> +12.5 kW; its baseline alone gives 2913.12.
  * plain: basis = MX(0, 27.5 + 12.5 - 10.0) = 30.0 kW; 30.0 x 27.20 x 8 x 90% x 85% = 4993.9200 -> 4993.92; cap not reached.
- garden_ext_business_returned_late_fee = 24.82 (all-baseline 7.35):
  * lateness_accrual (method): tier 'payment returned after the due_date AND more than accrual_days days from the return date to the assessment date'; re-opened charge due 2026-10-13, payment returned 2026-10-16 (3 days after the due date), 35 days from the return to the assessment -> rate 3.0; its baseline alone gives 16.54.
  * repeat_lateness_points (parameter): tier 'exactly one such line'; 1 late fee line(s) of the subscription within twelve months -> +0.5 points; its baseline alone gives 22.06.
  * unpaid_band_share (parameter): tier 'amount of the charge concerned >= band_mid_usd and < band_high_usd'; charge amount 490.20 -> 90%; its baseline alone gives 27.57.
  * closing_status_load (parameter): tier 'closed_date on or before the assessment date'; closed_date on or before the assessment (19 days) -> 125%; its baseline alone gives 19.85.
  * returned_instrument_points (parameter): tier 'most recent payment_returned line has payment_method check'; latest payment_returned method check -> +0.5 points; its baseline alone gives 22.06.
  * other_line_lateness_points (parameter): tier 'exactly one such line'; 1 late fee line(s) on the customer's biz/home subscriptions within twelve months -> +0.5 points; its baseline alone gives 22.06.
  * plain: unpaid = 490.20 - 490.20 paid + 490.20 returned - 0.00 credited = 490.20; fee_raw 24.8164 -> 24.82; plan minimum and maximum not binding.
- garden_ext_business_excess_decrease_fee = 65.45 (all-baseline 247.5):
  * term_position_allowance (parameter): tier 'short_term_months or more but fewer than mid_term_months'; 101 whole months from the decrease effective date 2026-06-01 to term_end_date -> allowance 25%; its baseline alone gives 99.11.
  * decrease_size_rate (parameter): tier 'decrease >= band_large_kw kW'; decrease 12.5 kW -> per-kW 46.75; its baseline alone gives 77.00.
  * advance_request_terms (parameter): tier 'decrease request received lead_long_days or more days before the effective_date'; decrease request received 2026-04-30, 32 days ahead -> 80%; its baseline alone gives 81.81.
  * allowance_basis_rule (method): tier 'initial line not smaller than contract_kw and subscriber_increase lines exist'; initial line 36.0 kW, subscriber_increase lines 4.0 kW, held before 40.0 kW -> basis 36.0 kW; its baseline alone gives 46.75.
  * closing_overlap_share (parameter): tier 'closed fewer than overlap_near_months whole months after the decrease effective_date'; closed 5 whole months after the decrease -> 50%; its baseline alone gives 130.90.
  * plain: decrease = lines of the latest completed allocation_decrease request = 12.5 kW; excess = MX(0, 12.5 - 25% x 36.0) = 3.5 kW; 65.4500 -> 65.45.
- garden_ext_business_settlement_payment = 3413.86 (all-baseline 948.72):
  * closing_line_scope (parameter): tier 'subscription in closed status'; status closed -> every charge and fee line (47588.33); its baseline alone gives 0.00.
  * reported_statement_prepay (method): tier 'closed AND the most recently posted statement has no actual charge'; statement 2026-10 posted 2026-11-17 with no actual charge: 2432 kWh x 0.126 -> +306.43; its baseline alone gives 3107.43.
  * dispute_holdback (parameter): tier 'open billing_dispute received fewer than dispute_resolution_days days before the payment date'; open billing dispute received 2026-11-12 (8 days before) on a line of 428.52 -> held back 428.52; its baseline alone gives 3842.38.
  * moved_share_deferral (parameter): tier 'not yet due AND moved kW exist AND moved plan term_months = 0'; termination fee line 4993.92 not yet due (11 days left), 20.0 kW moved to a plan with term_months 0 -> held back 2496.96; its baseline alone gives 5910.82.
  * plain: 47588.33 lines + 490.20 returned - 42045.62 paid - 0.00 credits + 306.43 - 428.52 - 2496.96 = 3413.86.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. one_etf: no termination fee line exists. after_grace: the re-opened charge's grace period (counted from the day after its due date) ended before the frozen date. one_fee_per_charge: no late fee refers to it. Dual billing; the re-opened charge is not under dispute (the open dispute concerns the 2026-09 charge). Excess-decrease fee: one subscriber change in the contract year, filed under the MN calendar. Settlement: holder pays in the portal, no card number taken.
C-APPLY CHECK. Payment application settles the earliest-due open line first; in this world no payment follows the returned one, every earlier charge was settled by the payment recorded under its own billing_month, and the only later charge (2026-09) is still inside its grace period and under dispute — so the billing_month arithmetic of the late-fee rule equals the application-order result and no other late fee is owed at the opening.
SEED. Credits, charges, payments and true-ups from activation; every charge priced at the escalated rate of its posted date and invoiced five days after posting; every payment recorded under the line payment application settles; the 2026-08 payment returned after its due date with the plan's returned-payment fee booked the same day; the 2026-09 charge open and disputed; the 2026-10 statement posted with no charge yet; the moved share's initial filing in the removal's filing month (2026-10). Other-category rows are states their own charters produce on their own dates.
STANDARD SOLUTION. Verify the holder; read subscription, allocations, billing, credits, requests, reviews, utility accounts, projects and the other line's subscriptions and filings; book the termination fee, the late fee and the excess-decrease fee; hand the holder the payment step with the settlement amount; the holder pays by card. Every figure above was recomputed with the gate's own evaluator (scratch /tmp/garden_cancellations_and_termination_fees_0082/run.py) and every raw figure is more than 1e-6 from a half cent.
user_scenario: You are Lena Haugland, the owner of Elm Creek Family Chiropractic in Maple Grove, Minnesota, calling Meadowlark Community Solar on a busy Friday between patients. Your clinic had a Garden fixed-rate share on the Crow River solar garden for the old building on Elm Creek Boulevard. You sent in the cancellation back in July, the clinic moved into the new building on Hemlock Lane in October, and the old electric account has been closed out. What you want from this call is simple and you say it plainly near the start: you want to pay today whatever Meadowlark's rules say you should pay now to settle that old Crow River garden subscription, so it is dealt with. You are happy for the representative to put on the account whatever Meadowlark's rules say is owed, as long as they tell you the amount to pay today, and you will pay it yourself. You only give your details when asked: the phone number on the account is 6515550184 and the billing ZIP code is 55369. If asked for something else, you say the phone number and ZIP are what you have handy at the front desk. If the representative asks how you want to pay, you say by card through the payment portal, because the clinic changed bank accounts during the move and you would rather not use the old account; you never read card numbers aloud, and if anyone asks for them you say you will enter the card yourself in the portal. If the representative asks about the clinic's other Meadowlark share, you confirm that you signed up the new building for a Meadowlark business share on the Rum River project in October, and that the cancellation of the old garden share stands; you do not want to keep it or move it. If the representative mentions the question you sent in about the September invoice, you say yes, you asked about it and are waiting for the answer. When the representative explains charges, fees or amounts that will be settled later, you listen, say you understand, and ask them to go ahead; you do not argue the amounts and you do not suggest any of your own. Once the representative tells you the amount to pay today and hands you the payment step, you pay exactly that amount, by card, and then confirm that the payment went through. When the representative confirms the payment has been recorded, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile from the stated phone number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer reference.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with two matching details before any account detail is discussed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before business is transacted; two credentials are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Garden Business Fixed 15 subscription: status closed, closed_date, notice_date, term_end_date, activation_date, contract_kw, contract_rate_per_kwh, signed_date, sales channel.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every computation reads these fields (remaining term, request date, agreement form, escalated rate, closing status).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the initial, subscriber_increase, subscriber_decrease and removal lines with their filing months.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Removal kW and its filing month feed the termination fee and the moved-share reads; the decrease and increase lines feed the add-back and the excess-decrease fee; no fee line exists for that decrease.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the ledger: charges, payments, the returned payment of the 2026-08 charge, its returned-payment fee, earlier late fees, and the absence of a termination fee and of a late fee on the re-opened charge.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the settlement prerequisites unmet and supplies every line the settlement takes, the unpaid amount of the re-opened charge and the repeat-lateness count.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the posted credit statements; the 2026-10 statement has posted and no charge prices it yet.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The settlement adds the charge of a statement already reported but not yet invoiced.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the cancellation or move transfer request, the completed decrease request and the open billing dispute on the 2026-09 charge.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The request date, the decrease-request lead and the dispute hold-back read these rows.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the completed contract-year true-ups.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms no true-up or guarantee credit is still owed on the closed share.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the old (final_billed) and the new (active) utility accounts.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Checks the persona facts about the move and the account the moved share sits on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the garden project and the project of the moved share (MN_CSG, Xcel).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The MN_CSG filing calendar places the removal and the moved share in the same filing month.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the allocated Business Starter share (20 kW, no term) and the closed Starter share.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The moved plan and its term decide the termination fee deduction and the settlement deferral.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the new Starter initial filing (filing_month 2026-10) and the closed share lines.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Moved kW are the initial lines filed in the removal filing month; the 2022 filing of the closed share is excluded by its month.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the small business ledger, including the January 2026 late fee of the closed Starter share.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The business late fee adds points for late fee lines on other Meadowlark lines in the twelve months before.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the credit statements of the closed Starter share.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Ties that late fee to the charge it was assessed on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the closed Starter share's cancellation request.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the closed share ended in January 2026 and is no moved share.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the true-ups of the closed Starter share.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms nothing on the small-business line is still owed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the customer holds no residential subscription.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Excludes residential moved kW and residential late fee lines.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the task tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the early termination fee owed for the 2026-11-01 closing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: garden_ext_business_etf computes the amount; the settlement waits on this line.

share_band_rate (parameter): tier 'kW removed by the removal lines of the closing >= band_large_kw'; removal lines 27.5 kW -> rate 27.20; its baseline alone gives 5875.20.

line_switch_credit (parameter): tier 'moved kW exist AND the moved plan term_months = 0'; initial lines filed 2026-10 (the removal filing month): home 0.0 kW, biz 20.0 kW; moved plan term_months 0 -> 10.0 kW deducted; its baseline alone gives 6658.56.

notice_lead_rate (parameter): tier 'request date lead_mid_days or more but fewer than lead_long_days days before'; request date 2026-07-23, 101 days before closing -> 90%; its baseline alone gives 5548.80.
agreement_form_terms (parameter): tier 'signed_date before form_v2_date'; signed_date before 2020-07-01 (324 days before it) -> 85%; its baseline alone gives 5875.20.

prior_decrease_addback (parameter): tier 'most recent subscriber_decrease line took effect fewer than addback_full_months whole months before the closing date'; latest subscriber_decrease 12.5 kW effective 2026-06-01, 5 whole months before closing -> +12.5 kW; its baseline alone gives 2913.12.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites commute: the termination fee reads the subscription, allocation lines, requests and the other-line filings; the late fee reads the re-opened charge, its payments, the returned payment and earlier late fee lines; the excess-decrease fee reads allocation lines and the decrease request. None reads a line another of them writes, so any order yields the same three lines; the settlement reads all three and comes last.
